subject: Recap: Nova Financial discovery — budget constraints & batching options
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@novafin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Nova Financial discovery — budget constraints & batching options

Hi Priyanka — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we heard and suggested next steps so your procurement team has something to work from. Please correct anything I got wrong.

Key pain points you confirmed:
- Token cost sensitivity for customer-facing credit decisioning flows (peak usage: ~250M tokens/month for scoring + prompts).
- Strict monthly budget cap for pilots: prefer <= $30k / month initially.
- Security requirements: SOC 2 Type II, option for VPC/private deployment for production.
- Latency SLO: sub-200ms tail for small inference requests (prompt length typically 40-80 tokens).

What we discussed (options + rough levers):
1) Hosted API + caching/batching (fastest on-ramp)
   - Automatic prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts (savings on repeated token work).
   - Continuous batching during business hours; expected token-cost reduction 25–45% depending on hit-rate.
   - Good fit if you want quick pilot without infra changes.

2) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs)
   - Predictable throughput and unit-cost savings once you commit; quantized model variants lower per-token ops.
   - Best if sustained heavy usage and you can commit to a monthly minimum.

3) Private deployment (VPC/on-prem)
   - Meets tight security/contracting requirements; longer lead time, separate pricing and license terms.

Rough econ framing (for discussion only):
- Hosted (with caching heuristics): ballpark $0.0006/token effective at 30–40% cache/hit and batching.
- Dedicated (reserved + quantized): ballpark $0.00033–0.00045/token depending on commit size and model selection.
- For a 6-month pilot at 250M tokens/month: hosted (with caching) ~ $45k/month; dedicated could approach your target with a reserve and 12+ month commitment.

Attached: redwood_tco_snapshot.xlsx (quick worksheet with scenarios), soc2-summary.pdf.

Immediate next steps we recommend:
- You confirm the procurement constraints (monthly cap, required contracts, procurement timeline).
- If test traffic is fixed at ~250M tokens/mo, indicate whether you prefer to aim for a hosted pilot under $30k/mo or explore a dedicated reserve (we can show exact numbers).
- Book a 30m technical & procurement sync (Ben + Marcus + Tom from Nova) — propose Mon/Tue next week.
- We will produce a 1-page options summary + estimated pilot cost for procurement (deliverable within 48 hours after you confirm target pilot profile).

Thanks — I’ll wait for your confirmation on target pilot budget and an initial procurement contact.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: redwood_tco_snapshot.xlsx (workbook), soc2-summary.pdf (overview)
From: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@novafin.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@novafin.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 13:29:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Recap: Nova Financial discovery — budget constraints & batching options

Olga — appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications and our constraints: 

- Procurement: we have a strict pilot ceiling of $30k / month without additional board approval.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II is required — any hosted option must provide SOC 2 evidence and an acceptable data isolation approach; VPC preferred for production.
- Timeline: procurement needs an itemized quote and SOW for a 6-month pilot to move quickly.
- Volume: yes our initial estimate is ~250M tokens/month, but first 2 months may be variable as we tune prompt engineering.

Can you provide a written one-pager with two recommended pilot configurations (hosted + caching vs. small dedicated reserve), including:
- Estimated monthly cost (line-itemed: compute, storage, support)
- Key SLO trade-offs (latency/throughput)
- Contract/commitment terms and procurement path (purchase order vs. direct contract)

Looping Tom from procurement — Tom, any questions on the technical side we should prioritize?

Thanks,
Priyanka
Sr. Product Manager, ML Platforms
Nova Financial
priyanka@novafin.com

Attachment: nova_procurement_form.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Priyanka Shah <priyanka@novafin.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Nova Financial discovery — budget constraints & batching options

Thanks Priyanka — quick note from the pricing side and proposed technical next steps.

Pricing notes (very high level, will formalize into the one-pager Olga mentioned):
- Hosted + caching (pilot): we can structure a 6-month pilot that targets <= $30k/mo by combining an initial usage credit and conservative caching assumptions. Example model: 250M tokens * $0.0006 = $150k/mo gross; with caching & credits we can bring sticker closer to $30–40k/mo for first 2–3 months while you validate accuracy and hit rates.
- Dedicated reserve: if Nova is comfortable committing to a 12-month reserve with a smaller onboarding (6-month pilot scoped as a subset), we can show per-token closer to $0.00035–0.00045. This requires a modest monthly reservation (we'll show exact numbers).

Technical ask — Marcus, can you join a 30m deep-dive to:
- Validate latency & model selection for 40–80 token prompts;
- Show expected caching hit-rate using a small sample of Nova prompts;
- Walk procurement through the VPC/private deployment options and lead time.

Priyanka / Tom — proposed times (PT): Mon 06/07 10:00 or Tue 06/08 11:30. Which works for you?

Olga and I will prepare the 1-pager after you confirm target pilot profile (hosted-first with credits vs dedicated-reserve).

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben — Tue 06/08 11:30 PT works for Tom and me.

A couple of quick asks before the call so procurement can triage: 
- Please send the one-pager with the two pilot configurations (hosted + caching vs dedicated small reserve) and estimated costs line-itemed. We need that to pre-fill the procurement form and speed approvals.
- Please attach SOC 2 evidence (the soc2-summary.pdf you referenced is fine).

For the tech sync, Tom will share a sample of 1–2 weeks of anonymized prompts ahead of time. Marcus, if you can run a quick cache-hit simulation on that sample before the call, that would be very helpful.

See you Tuesday.

Best,
Priyanka
